# Phase Three — Testing Universe

> A test is a measured vessel for truth; the Awtsmoos renews each execution, and evidence—not confidence—proves the route.

## Structural gates

- Node parse/import of every touched module.
- B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He headers on touched human-authored source.
- tabs for indentation; reject leading-space indentation in touched source.
- no touched source over the modularity ceiling without explicit documented reason.
- no minified/cramped functions.

## New facade tests

- factory returns stable five methods and expert namespaces;
- define canonicalizes without mutation;
- malformed definitions fail validation with structured diagnostics;
- traits/relationships/constraints/behaviors survive serialization;
- plan is deterministic for same seed/request;
- compiler registration/discovery remains serializable;
- requested artifact channels drive plan selection;
- unsupported/deferred channels remain truthful;
- compiler versions/cost/LOD/quality appear where existing planner supports them;
- compile returns provenance/hash/channel truth;
- world transactional namespace retains history/undo/redo/serialization;
- explanation does not execute compiler side effects;
- semantic hashes remain stable across read-only operations.

## Inherited Aug. 31 debt

Run tests for quantity, provenance, identity receipts, fluent authoring, derivation, compile policy, namespace exports, then reread the authored-semantics touched files and close their previous REMAINING_WORK.

- fresh-browser public production verification after deployment.
